Cache miss → hit verified via X-Thumb-Cache header (value 'miss' on 1st call, 'hit' on 2nd). Backend code is correct; this is an ingress/CDN issue affecting both preview AND likely production.

critical.issue: Cloudflare/Emergent ingress strips backend's Cache-Control 'private, max-age=604800, immutable' and replaces with 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. This defeats the iter51 design goal of letting the BROWSER cache thumbnails by URL on repeat visits. Verified: direct uvicorn (localhost:8001) returns the correct headers; through ingress (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) the headers are rewritten. Service Worker sw-thumbs.js still works (it forces cache.put regardless of Cache-Control) so the user-facing benefit is partially preserved on the same page session, but cross-session browser cache hits are lost.

rca of the issue: User-reported slow Job Photos loading: iter51 fixes are SOUND at the application layer. (1) pillow-heif registered → iPhone HEIC will decode now (was rendering as raw HEIC bytes labeled image/jpeg before, which browsers can't display). (2) Mongo thumb cache survives redeploys (disk was ephemeral). (3) /thumb-signed?t= lets work directly without axios+blob+objectURL bottleneck → Service Worker can finally cache. (4) SystemHealthBadge requires 2 fails before red → no more spurious red banners during gallery loads. ONE NEW ISSUE FOUND: ingress overrides Cache-Control to no-store, defeating the BROWSER cache portion of the strategy (Service Worker cache still works since it doesn't honor Cache-Control on put). Net effect: same-session repeat views are instant via SW, cross-session repeat views may re-hit the network. Mitigation: SW cache covers the dominant user pattern (returning to a job within a session); cross-session impact is bounded by 7-day Mongo thumb cache → first-visit of the day is one Mongo lookup per photo, not a Pillow render.
